title: Classify Automation and AI Use Cases
prompt: Classify each scenario into the corresponding automation or AI capability category.

items.label: Automatically create a new employee's account and assign role-based permissions
Deploy a virtual machine on demand from an approved template
Compare actual configuration against the baseline and remediate drift
Spot an anomaly in logs based on a baseline
Conversational assistant that helps the analyst draft their notes
Anticipate an outage based on observed trends
Behavioral baseline enhanced by machine learning
AI agent that chains triage, blocking, and documentation under guardrails
Create, assign, and close a ticket from an alert

explain: Provisioning and desired state act on resources; detection produces signals; ticketing handles coordination; the four AI capabilities (chatbot, prediction, augmented baselines, agentic AI) form the final category.
